Each row has ONE complete occupied German service vehicle, always strict flat LEFT-facing side elevation with barrel perfectly horizontal, bottom of treads horizontal. Show the whole side, wheels full circles, only one side visible, no perspective, ground, shadows, captions, outlines of panels or background objects. Keep each tank at approximately the same displayed width, generous transparent margin, well separated rows. In this order TOP: Fiat-Ansaldo M15/42 (medium tank NOT a Semovente), recognisable Italian riveted angular hull, distinctive TWO four-wheel bogie groups (8 small road wheels), high small faceted rotating turret and projecting medium-length single barrel facing left, dull dark yellow/olive with brown-green blotches.
